subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI’s visible history store, and if so through which supported boundary?
rationale: The remaining fix depends on accepting external Open WebUI persistence ownership, choosing direct SQLite/schema coupling versus an API/plugin boundary, deciding operator opt-in configuration, and deciding whether historical backfill is in scope.

options.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Add an operator-enabled sync path with schema/API version handling, docs, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Keep OpenClaw transcript/model context as the owned source and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

options.title: Route to plugin or integration boundary
options.body: Keep core unchanged unless a plugin or extension API is needed to support this external sync safely.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Add an operator-enabled sync path with schema/API version handling, docs, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway chat persistence history and adjacent Control UI documentation work make this the best available owner for the boundary decision.
